description: This file contains the implementation of a generic class `StreamSubscriptionHandleImpl<T>` which represents a subscription handle for a stream in the Orleans streaming infrastructure. It manages subscription state, delivery, resumption, and unsubscription logic, and interacts with stream implementation details and observers.

classes.name: StreamSubscriptionHandleImpl<T>
classes.description: A concrete implementation of a stream subscription handle that manages subscription lifecycle, message delivery, and state for a specific stream in Orleans.

methods.name: Invalidate
methods.description: Invalidates the handle, clearing references to stream and observers.

methods.name: GetSequenceToken
methods.description: Returns the expected sequence handshake token for the stream.

methods.name: ResumeAsync
methods.description: Resumes the subscription with a given observer or batch observer.

methods.name: DeliverBatch
methods.description: Delivers a batch of events to the observer, managing tokens for ordered streams.

methods.name: DeliverItem
methods.description: Delivers a single item to the observer, with type casting and token management.

methods.name: NextBatch
methods.description: Processes a batch container and dispatches contained events to the observer.

methods.name: NextItem
methods.description: Dispatches a single item to the observer.

methods.name: NextItems
methods.description: Dispatches multiple items to the batch observer.

methods.name: ErrorInStream
methods.description: Signals an error in the stream to the observer.

methods.name: SameStreamId
methods.description: Checks if the given stream ID matches the stream implementation's internal ID.

methods.name: Equals (StreamSubscriptionHandle<T>)
methods.description: Checks equality based on subscription ID.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code based on the subscription ID.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the subscription handle.
